records.name: Hubrist Hochhinaus
records.biography_en: Has mistaken being above the others for having found a better view. His HyperNorm ladder makes height look like evidence of better judgement. A dissonant card asks who can still reach him when he wants company. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Übersicht wurde mit ausreichender Höhe begründet.

variant_notes.note_en: Has mistaken being above the others for having found a better view.

records.name: Herr Spätergern
records.biography_en: Has kept tomorrow beautifully clear by moving everything into it. His HyperNorm calendar keeps tomorrow empty enough to hold everything unfinished. A dissonant card offers to open one letter with him today. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Morgen bleibt durch fortgesetzte Verlegung sorgfältig frei.

variant_notes.note_en: Has kept tomorrow beautifully clear by moving everything into it.

records.name: Neidia Nebenan
records.biography_en: Knows exactly what is missing because somebody else appears to have it. Her HyperNorm binoculars locate the prize missing from her own little stand. A dissonant card asks what she would notice without the comparison. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Mangel wurde durch Besichtigung fremden Besitzes bestätigt.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows exactly what is missing because somebody else appears to have it.

records.name: Gierwart Nochmünze
records.biography_en: Is almost satisfied and would like to postpone almost by one more coin. His HyperNorm coin promises that satisfaction is one small addition away. A dissonant card asks whether he can taste anything while counting. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Genugtuung liegt nur noch eine Münze weiter.

variant_notes.note_en: Is almost satisfied and would like to postpone almost by one more coin.

records.name: Sturkopf Festgelegt
records.biography_en: Has remained consistent long enough to regard movement as a personal insult. His HyperNorm block defends a position long after the original obstacle has moved. A dissonant card asks whether changing his mind would make the old effort meaningless. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Beständigkeit erhebt gegen jede Bewegung Einwand.

variant_notes.note_en: Has remained consistent long enough to regard movement as a personal insult.

records.name: Prachtfrau Unübersehbar
records.biography_en: Would be modest if modesty came with a more visible arrangement. Her HyperNorm feathers arrange attention into a pleasingly inevitable direction. A dissonant card asks whether she can enjoy the colour when nobody turns. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bescheidenheit benötigt eine auffälligere Ausführung.

variant_notes.note_en: Would be modest if modesty came with a more visible arrangement.
